hook: Your steps here land on about 40,000 stone columns.
title: A Path Made of 40,000 Stone Columns
description:
The Giant's Causeway in Northern Ireland is made of about 40,000 interlocking stone columns. Many of them are hexagons that fit together like tiles. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and it is real.

#Shorts #Geography #GiantsCausewayNorthernIreland
comment_prompt: Natural or man-made? Natural or fake
